dialog.apiKeyOptionalNote: The API Key can be left blank; after entering the API endpoint you can fetch the model list, and the system will pick a default model.
dialog.baseUrlHintCreate: Enter an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, usually ending with /v1; a common local Ollama address is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
dialog.baseUrlHintEdit: Leave blank to use the default address; a common local Ollama address is http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.
dialog.imageApiHint: Image generation calls this provider's OpenAI-compatible image API.
dialog.imageModelHint: Once set, character portrait generation can use this provider; leave it blank to use it for text models only.
dialog.keyPlaceholderKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved API Key
dialog.modelInputPlaceholder: You can also enter the model name manually
dialog.primaryModelHintCreate: After fetching the model list, the first available model is filled in automatically; if the API returns no list, you can enter one manually.
dialog.primaryModelHintCustomRefresh: You can click "Refresh models" on the provider card to fetch the list, or enter a default model manually.
dialog.primaryModelHintDefault: If the target model is not in the list, you can enter it manually.
maintenance.description: Check for desktop updates or import legacy local data; these actions will not affect your current creation settings.
maintenance.noDesktopTasks: There are no desktop maintenance tasks to handle in the current environment.
maintenance.noNeedHint: When there is nothing to maintain, you can return directly to the creation settings above.
maintenance.title: System maintenance
nav.knowledge.description: You can start writing without configuring this; once enabled, long-form settings, references, and context recall become more reliable.
nav.knowledge.title: Knowledge base vector settings
nav.routes.description: Choose available models for outlining, chapter splitting, prose generation, and review tasks.
nav.routes.hint: When routing is healthy, the auto director and chapter production automatically select models by task.
nav.routes.title: Model routing
providerSection.description: First make sure at least one text model is available; balance details, request limits, and the model list can be checked under advanced details.
providerSection.title: Model providers
readiness.canStart: The core creation pipeline is ready; you can start a new novel or keep progressing an existing one.
readiness.cannotStart: Handle the items marked "Needs attention" first; entering the auto director or chapter production afterward will be more reliable.
readiness.description: First confirm the models and routes required to start writing are available; the knowledge base is an enhancement you can add later.
readiness.itemModelReady: {{name}} is ready for prose and planning generation.
readiness.itemModelWarning: Configure an available model first, then you can start outlining and generating chapters.
readiness.itemRagOptional: You can start writing without configuring this; enabling it enhances settings, references, and context recall.
readiness.itemRagReady: Knowledge base retrieval is enabled, helping long-form writing keep references and settings consistent.
readiness.itemRoutesChecking: Checking model compatibility for outlining, chapter splitting, prose generation, and review tasks.
readiness.itemRoutesReady: Creation tasks already have available routes, and later steps will select models by task.
readiness.itemRoutesWarning: Some creation tasks still need model routes added or fixed.
readiness.itemStyleReady: The style extraction wait time is within the valid range and ready to learn a sample's style.
readiness.itemStyleWarning: Please make sure the style extraction wait time is within the valid range.
readiness.title: Creation readiness check
requestLimit.concurrencyHint: 0 means unlimited. Requests to the same provider and model beyond the limit are queued.
requestLimit.intervalHint: 0 means unlimited. Controls how fast consecutive requests are sent to the same provider and model.
statusCard.balanceCustomNotSupported: Custom providers do not support balance queries yet.
statusCard.balanceNeedConfig: Please configure the API Key first.
statusCard.customBalanceNotSupported: Custom OpenAI-compatible providers do not support balance queries yet.
statusCard.reasoningOff: Reasoning content is currently hidden; MiniMax automatically strips thinking content from the body.
statusCard.reasoningOn: The model's reasoning content is currently returned and displayed.
statusCard.refreshBalanceDisabledReason: This provider cannot refresh its balance directly.
statusCard.refreshDisabledReason: You can refresh the model list after configuring the API Key.
statusCard.testDisabledReason: You can test the connection after configuring the API Key.
statusCard.usableAfterConfig: Ready for creation tasks once configured.
style.description: Controls the maximum time style extraction waits for the model to respond. Raise it for long source texts; keep it short for short texts to spot issues more easily.
style.integerHint: Please enter an integer between {{min}} and {{max}} minutes.
style.modeFastDescription: Best for short text or quickly confirming whether a sample's style can be extracted.
style.modeLongDescription: Best for long source texts or slower models, giving the extraction process more time.
style.modeStableDescription: Best for most style extraction tasks, balancing wait time and error detection.
style.rangeHint: Allowed range: {{min}}-{{max}} minutes. After saving, newly submitted and retried style extraction tasks will use this wait time.
style.saveError: Failed to save style engine runtime settings.
style.saveSuccess: Style engine runtime settings saved successfully.
style.title: Style engine runtime settings
